verdict.rationale: Bento documents an official Python SDK with installation pages, an optional Google ADK extra, `init()` configuration with user, session and tag kwargs, `bento.track_ai` for manual instrumentation, `bento.flush()` for short-lived processes, and an OpenTelemetry transport, so a developer can build against it directly. Missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs beyond Python (the TypeScript path relies on generic OpenTelemetry exporters with no Bento package), and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: If you use **Google ADK**, install the extra so Bento can capture every call automatically
Wrap any LLM or tool call with bento.track_ai. Manual events for SDKs without an integration.
Short-lived script or Lambda | Call `bento.flush()` before exit.
